plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Spanish BA program PDF. The program publishes three sample graduation plans (students entering SPAN 1010; heritage students entering SPAN 3010; native speakers entering SPAN 3060); this seed models the SPAN 1010 entry plan, the default plan for students beginning with no or very little background. That plan officially includes a 2nd-year Summer term (Recommended Summer Study Abroad; SPAN 3040, 4 credits). Semester totals as printed: 15 / 16 / 16 / 13 / 4 (summer) / 15 / 15 / 12 / 13 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119'. The program curriculum header states '120 credits'; the official graduation plan itself prints and sums to 119, so total_credits follows the plan as printed. Course titles verified against the program's 2025-2026 Program Curriculum section (SPAN 3060 Advanced Spanish: Human Writing in the Tech Era; SPAN 3075 Intro to Spanish Linguistics; SPAN 3080 Spanish Pronunciation; SPAN 3390 Intro to Literature in Spanish: you can also be a writer.; SPAN 4550 Cultures of Spain; SPAN 4560 Spanish American Culture; SPAN 4610 Love and Treason in Medieval literature of Spain; SPAN 4620 Modern Age and Contemporary Literature of Spain; SPAN 4630 Colonial Spanish American Literature; SPAN 4640 Contemporary Spanish American Lit.: Novel and Film; SPAN 4800 Spanish Senior Capstone; SPAN 3040 Intermediate Grammar and Oral Proficiency; SPAN 3070 Advanced Grammar, Culture and Composition II). 'SPAN upper-division elective' and 'Upper Division Elective' slots per the plan; the 12-credit Spanish Electives list is in the program curriculum. Prerequisites not populated from the plan (the graduation plan does not list them); see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
